why:
I checked all four must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one.
(1) Builder step 7 says: "Run `npm install` at the repo root so package-lock.json picks up the new workspace, and commit the updated package-lock.json; otherwise `npm ci` in the test workflow fails."
(2) Builder step 6 says to "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet with a bullet listing `packages/jsonl-lint`", so it replaces the line rather than adding one.
(3) Verifier Check 6 runs `npm ci && npm test` at the root, and its PASS condition requires the jsonl-lint tests to be "among those run". That means a silent skip under --if-present would be a failure. The advisory mutation check adds to this.
(4) Check 6 uses the REST API (gh api) to find the PR whose body contains the exact Closes line and to get its head.sha. It then reads the check-runs at that sha, requires `test` to be "completed success", and makes sure the sha matches the checked-out HEAD.
